entries.2d15a4a5b809c7c0: The company is a railway-specialized trading company that has done business with the former Japanese National Railways (now the JR companies) since its founding and operates bases nationwide from Hokkaido to Kyushu. Through a stock function that always holds more than 4,000 items in inventory, the company shortens the period from order to delivery compared with shipments directly from manufacturers. It has exclusive distributorship agreements and agency agreements with its major suppliers, and it shares customer demand information with suppliers, which also leads to the development of new products.
entries.2fe15f3046a4507e: Targeting customers other than those in the Railway Business, it handles connectors and electronic components as its main products. It also handles repair and modification supplies for overseas thermal power plants, various processed wire harnesses, power supply units and others. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, sales to external customers were ¥2,502 million.
entries.3683e8c27ead88e9: Its main products are railway vehicle products, and it handles electrical equipment for railway vehicles, body parts, on-board equipment, connectors, electronic components and others. The consolidated subsidiary Yaxima (Shanghai) Trading Co., Ltd. sells products in China, and Yashima Butsuryū Co., Ltd. stores inventory and handles receipts and shipments at its Ikuta Office. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, sales to external customers were ¥31,362 million.
entries.3a4d5268d921a341: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥33,864 million (up 16.6% year on year). By segment, the Railway Business was the largest at ¥31,362 million, and the General Business was ¥2,502 million.

entries.79915647ab817ac7: The company has set a 3-year medium-term management plan covering fiscal 2024 to fiscal 2026, and its basic goals are a return to a stable growth path and the creation of new corporate value. Its basic policies are: strengthening the foundation of existing businesses and raising added value; developing new businesses through the selection of growth areas and a review of personnel allocation; improving profitability in the General Segment and building a structure that secures profitability; developing global markets through participation in ODA railway infrastructure projects; strengthening growth capacity through investment in human capital; and strengthening collaboration as a group. As its code of conduct, it upholds the “3 Gen” principle, with the keywords “genba, genbutsu, genjitsu” (the workplace, the actual item and the actual situation).
